ped_waiting.value: 36 months of continuous coverage after the first policy start (an optional cover can cut this to 24 or 12 months)

specific_waiting.value: 24 months of continuous coverage for the listed conditions and surgeries (includes cataract)

initial_waiting.value: 30 days from the first policy start, except claims arising from an accident

room_rent.value: Room Rent up to a Single Private AC room (the Room Modifier optional cover can change this)
room_rent.clause: Basic Cover 1 In-patient Treatment, i. Room Rent

copay.value: Voluntary Co-Payment is an optional cover (Optional Cover 19); it applies only if chosen

maternity.value: Optional add-on only: Maternity Benefit up to 10% of the Sum Insured

ayush.value: In-patient AYUSH treatment at a Government Recognized AYUSH Hospital or AYUSH Day Care Centre
ayush.clause: Basic Cover 6 In Patient AYUSH Hospitalization

daycare.value: Robotic surgeries covered as a listed Technological Advancement treatment, up to the Sum Insured and sub-limits
daycare.clause: Basic Cover 3 Technological Advancements and Treatments, item 7

pre_post.clause: Basic Cover, Pre- and Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses

ncb.value: Loyalty Bonus of 20% for each policy year, up to 100% of the Sum Insured

renewal.value: Grace period of 30 days (15 days for monthly premium) without loss of continuity

sublimits.value: Cataract has no separate money limit in the base cover (the Vital Essence add-on sets ₹30,000); it waits 24 months
